_comment: PROPOSED machine-readable cost-of-record sidecar. NOT YET CANONICAL.
_status: proposal by copilot 2026-11-24; awaiting operator sign-off because it changes 34_FINAL_PICKS_2026-11-23/COST_OF_RECORD.md which is operator-owned and declares itself canonical.
_why: 21 tracked files quote equity as a single number (12.0749). Rewriting 21 dated round artefacts is wrong; they are historical records. The durable fix is ONE machine-readable source that docs and pick rows read, plus a CI guard that fails when a doc quotes a single-value equity cost.

grading_rule.rationale: A floor that omits commission is not a cost; a ceiling that cannot be below the true spread is not a cost either. Grade at the end that cannot flatter a strategy.

etf._open_item: no bracket exists for ETF. Needed before any ETF-vs-equity claim is made in either direction.

basis.floor: Corwin-Schultz + SEC, usable on 65/191 names — volatility swamps it elsewhere. NEVER GRADE HERE.
basis.central: Roll + SEC, 190/191 names — the verdict-grade estimate
basis.ceiling: 1-min bar-range upper bound, 13 megacaps — an upper bound, it cannot be below the true spread

equity._conflict_to_resolve: COST_OF_RECORD.md describes 12.0749 as 'spread + impact at 0.008% ADV participation'; the settlement doc describes the same number as a 1-min bar-range ceiling on 13 megacaps. Two different provenance claims for one number — the operator must pick one.

crypto.basis: measured band; midpoint used for any netting exercise
crypto._note: 40 bp is NOT ours — it is an external reviewer's assumption. 20 = band low, 36 = midpoint, 52 = high.
crypto._meme_venue_reality: a thin-DEX meme round turn is realistically 100-500 bp (swap fee x2 + priority x2 + slippage x2 + MEV). The 20-52 band is large-cap CEX.

hurdle.name: HURDLE_TBILL_APR
hurdle.sensitivity: moving to the realised SGOV CAGR 3.89% shifts the 1-day crypto requirement by 1.1pp and equity/ETF by 0.5pp; no verdict changes

turnover_convention.unit: round turns = one buy + one sell
turnover_convention.warning: if read as one-way trades, all drag figures halve

required_gross_pct._comment: COMPOUNDED solve: ((1+g_d)(1-c))^N = 1+h. Do NOT use h + N*c — that is linear and understates high-turnover rows.
required_gross_pct._supersedes: the linear figures 14.4 / 21.2 / 23.3 / 54.7 / 95.0 published in cost_of_hurdle.py

unmeasured_cost_stack: market impact / slippage / MEV — every bp above has includes_impact=false
taxes — at daily turnover short-term gains can exceed the transaction cost outright; jurisdiction-dependent
stop-level fill risk — a stop on an illiquid name fills far from the stop price
survivorship — every series used is of instruments that still exist

measured_meme_intrabar._source: Binance public klines, 999 daily bars per symbol, low-vs-open
measured_meme_intrabar._why: a session gap cannot exist in a 24/7 market (open_t ~= close_t-1 in 41.5-57.0% of bars exactly), so gap-through-stop must be replaced by intrabar excursion
measured_meme_intrabar._reading: on WIF, 22.9% of days broke a -5% stop then closed back above it: the stop fired and the trade was still right. 5.7x BTC's 4.0%. Tight stops are unusable on meme coins.
